important_boundaries: Existing principal-building work under CAD 26,000 before tax can be exempt only for listed categories and only when no always-required trigger applies.
Foundation, structure or interior-wall work is always permit-required regardless of cost.
Adding or closing an opening is always permit-required regardless of cost.
PIIA or heritage-citation applicability defeats the ordinary under-CAD-26,000 exemption.
The public summary says 'less than 26,000' for exemption and 'more than 26,000' for required renovation; exact CAD 26,000 is intentionally routed to municipal confirmation in Phase 0.
Permanent detached accessory structures require a permit; movable detached accessory structures do not, but zoning standards still apply.
Porch/balcony/gallery/terrace/exterior stair/ramp/awning/canopy is listed as permit-exempt when not subject to PIIA/heritage approval.
